keineFunke: No radio found – plug it in using serial mode
freigabe: Please allow remote control on the radio
hilfe: Click = tap · Right-click or hold = long tap · Drag = swipe
Mouse wheel, ↑/↓ = rotary encoder · Enter = ENTER · Esc = RTN · Tab = PAGE
F1 = SYS · F2 = MDL · F3 = DISP · Shift + key = long press
f_anschlussZu: Cannot open the port – is another program using the radio?
f_kabelGetrennt: The connection to the radio was lost
f_freigabeZeit: Remote control was not allowed on the radio (time out)
f_freigabeAbgelehnt: Remote control was refused on the radio
f_hallo: The radio does not answer as expected
f_simulatorWeg: The simulator does not answer any more
keineModelle: No models yet. Connect the radio or choose the SD drive, then «Load models». A model appears once it has been loaded with a Lua that supports the studio.
quelleHinweis: For «Connected radio» connect in the «Radio live» tab first.
luaUnbekanntLang: The studio has no description for this Lua (studio/beschreibung.json). Please update Lua-Studio.
platzWaehlen: Click a box to edit it. Drag to move, the bottom right corner resizes.
exportDateiHilfe: Fallback: save the studio file and copy it by hand to scripts/studio on the SD card.
exportDateiOk: Saved: {pfad}. Put it on the radio as scripts/studio/{datei} (folder studio next to the Lua folder, SD card or internal storage), then change the model once.
exportDateiSymbole: The layout uses symbols: the pictures are not in the file. Without them the Lua shows the boxes without symbols.
keineInfoDateien: No models found: there is no info file on the radio yet. Load the model with the widget once on the radio (the Lua then writes scripts/studio/<id>.<lua>.info.json), then «Load models».
extraWarnung: This layout uses {was}. It needs {lua} {version} or newer on the radio; older versions show only a number there. Continue anyway?
exportDateiNeu: Copy the file to the folder scripts/studio on the radio (SD card or internal storage). If the file name does not match the model name, choose the file in the widget menu under «Studio layout». If the window size does not match exactly, the Lua scales the view.
exportDateiName: File name: the part before «.lua» must match the model name on the radio. Model «{modell}» → «{kennung}» (every byte except A–Z, a–z, 0–9 becomes «_», so umlauts become «__», at most 32 bytes). If the model has another name, rename the file accordingly.
exportDateiGroessen: The file only takes effect if the widget window has exactly this size: {groessen}. In another zone the Lua shows its default display. After copying, change the model once.
vorbereitenZone: The layout only takes effect in the window sizes of the group (full screen or compact zone). If the widget uses another zone on the radio, it needs its own view: then better set it up with the radio connected.
altesLua: old Lua «{alt}» on the radio – please update
grenzwerte: Limits and alarms (per value, for the whole model)
werteAnpassen: Adjust values (applies everywhere, also to limits and announcements)
vorlageFrage: Replace layout, limits and settings of this model with the template?
kopierenFrage: Take over layout, limits and settings from this model?
funkeUebernehmen: Take over changes from the radio (the change file on the radio is deleted afterwards)
funkeKaputt: The change file on the radio is broken; the radio discards it anyway.
anordnungFehlerFrage: Some boxes are marked red. The radio discards boxes that are too small or outside the edge; overlapping boxes or boxes on an area the Lua draws itself end up underneath. Transfer anyway?
f_ordnerAnlegen: Cannot create the folder on the radio
f_liste: Cannot read the folder on the radio
f_u_funkeGeloescht: Change file on the radio taken over and deleted
f_u_modellNichtGeladen: Could not reload the model – please switch the model once on the radio
f_u_modellSelbstLaden: Please switch the model once on the radio so the Lua reads the new file
f_u_vergleichFehler: Read back differs from written – old file restored
pReserviert: lies on an area the Lua draws itself
keinPlatz: No free space for a new box. Shrink or remove a box first.
beideLeerWerk: Both levels empty: the radio uses the factory limit. Completely off only with «Off».
keinAlarmEingestellt: No alarm set: enter a warning or alarm first
motorAusAlle: Turn «also with motor off» on or off for all alarms
motorAusErklaerung: Ticked (default): the alarm also sounds while the motor switch (e.g. SF) is off. Error codes and shutdown reasons always sound.
motorAusImmer: Shutdown reason: always sounds, also with motor off
motorAusZeile: This alarm stays silent while the motor switch is off
motorAusBand: These alarms stay silent while the motor switch is off:
motorAusLuaKenntNicht: The Lua on the radio does not know «also with motor off» yet – there the alarm still sounds. Update the Lua.
doppeltLang: Another model gives the same file name (upper/lower case does not count on the SD card). Please rename one of the models on the radio, otherwise they share their settings.
funkeGiltWeiter: without the tick these changes keep applying on the radio on top of the new file.
fReihenfolge: alarm and warning swapped (with «below» the alarm must be lower, with «above» higher)
fBereich: range: max must be greater than min
fStufen: colour steps must be numbers in ascending order
f_u_schreibenAbgebrochen: Writing aborted (connection?) – the radio shows its default until the next transfer. Backup of the old file
f_u_vergleichFehlerGeloescht: Read back differs from written – file removed from the radio again (there was no old one)
f_u_funkeKaputtGeloescht: Change file on the radio was broken – backed up and deleted
f_lesen: Cannot read the file on the radio – nothing changed
f_ordnerUnbekannt: Folder not approved – please choose it again
fRichtungLua: direction does not match the Lua (the radio would use the factory limit)
modellnameFunke: Model name exactly as on the radio
presetFrage: Replace this model's layout with the preset? Limits and settings stay.
symboleNurFormat2: Symbols and decoration need a Lua version that supports format 2.
vorbereitetFrage: Apply the prepared layout, limits and settings to this model?
tonBleibt: Announcement and vibration off: the Lua still plays a tone on alarm. Fully silent only with “off”.
exportHinweis: Prepared model: write as studio file to an SD card (card reader or radio as drive) or to a folder.
vorbereitetLoeschenFrage: Move this prepared model to the trash?
wegfall_luaKannNicht2: This Lua version does not support format 2: symbols and decoration are dropped.
f_u_alteDateiBleibt: Old studio file with the former Lua name stays on the radio
f_u_symboleBleiben: Unused symbols stay on the radio
symboleLoeschen: Delete {n} unused symbols from the radio when transferring (no studio file names them any more)
f_u_symboleNichtAufgeraeumt: Symbols not cleaned up (a studio file was unreadable)
f_u_kennungKonflikt: The target already has this identifier with different case – nothing written
f_modellname: Model name missing or too long
vorbereitetAngebot: There is a layout prepared without the radio for this model. Apply it now?
f_symbolAndereGruppe: The target already holds this symbol for another display size (file of another model). Nothing written
f_u_symbolAndereGruppe: Symbol for another display size in the target, nothing written
schnelltestHinweis: reads the info file and Lua log of the connected radio (runs automatically after a transfer when the radio reloads the model)
st_infoFehlt: Info file missing (load the model on the radio once)
st_infoAlt: Info file not rewritten since the transfer – switch the model on the radio and test again
st_studioGeladen: Studio file loaded by the Lua
st_studioFelder: Invalid fields reported by the Lua
st_formatNicht: The Lua does not support this format
st_ansichtAngepasst: View scaled because the window size does not match exactly; source
st_keineMenueWahl: The Lua on the radio is older: it finds the studio file only by the model name and does not know the «Studio layout» choice in the widget menu yet. Update the Lua
st_keineSensoren: No sensors in the info file (the Lua probably queries the sensor list the wrong way, format v1 §14)
schnelltestUnsicher: Quick test without a reliable result: the info file is still the old one. Switch the model on the radio and test again
schnelltestNachWechsel: The radio did not reload the model: switch the model on the radio once, then press «Radio quick test»
st_studioGeladenAlt: Studio file loaded (old state before the transfer)
nichtSichtbarFrage: You only changed views that the Lua does not show on the radio right now. You will not see a change on the radio. Transfer anyway?
st_ansichtNichtSichtbar: The radio does not show the changed views right now; the Lua last ran in
protokollHinweis: Lua-Studio records here what happens and every error. If something goes wrong: “Save for support” and send the ZIP file. Folder:
protokollGespeichert: Saved: {pfad} ({n} files, {i} info files from the radio)
protokollAusHinweis: Level “off”: nothing is recorded, not even errors.
anordnenOkVerteilen: Distributed: sizes kept, all gaps {g} px, remaining space shared evenly at the edges. “Undo” works.
anordnenFesteSpalte: The column with the reserved area keeps its width.
anordnen_verschachtelt: This layout cannot be split into rows and columns (boxes interlock) – nothing changed. Tip: “New grid”.
anordnen_zuKlein: Box {n} would become smaller than allowed ({mb} × {mh} px) – nothing changed. Choose a smaller gap, another mode or fewer boxes.
anordnen_zuEng: Not enough room for this layout – nothing changed.
anordnen_reserviert: Box {n} lies on an area of the Lua – move it away first, then arrange. Nothing changed.
anordnen_rasterPasstNicht: No grid fits all minimum sizes – nothing changed.
startFunkeVerbunden: The radio is connected. Load the models and pick one.
startFunkeGetrennt: Connect the radio by USB in “Serial” mode and connect at the top (tab “Radio live”).
startVorbereitenText: Design a model for a display group, even without the radio. Later transfer it to the radio or assign it to the radio's model.
anordnenAbstandKleiner: {G} px did not fit, the boxes are closer: gap reduced to {g} px.
anordnen_ueberlappt: Boxes {n} and {m} overlap – pull them apart first, then arrange. Nothing changed.
